## Summary

Describe the user-visible or architectural change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant Python tests pass.
- [ ] `flutter analyze` and relevant Flutter tests pass.
- [ ] Shell changes pass `bash -n` or the applicable PowerShell check.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.

## Trust and release boundaries

- [ ] No private corpus, questions, progress, logs, credentials, signing material,
      build output, or Graphify output is included.
- [ ] Imported content and model output remain untrusted.
- [ ] This change does not add telemetry, a hosted account dependency, automatic
      model downloads, or a remote publisher-operated API.
- [ ] Legal, privacy, security, and third-party notices were updated together if
      the distribution or data boundary changed.
